SS-ADAPTER-UX.Purpose: Shared user-visible status and diagnostic policy for FLI context delivery across harnesses.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Common event meaning, message content, path identity, default/strict diagnostic policy.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Harness-specific presentation through native user-visible surfaces.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Core graph semantics and read classification.

Principles.PRIN-001: Notices describe documents newly delivered to the current context; one read event yields at most one delivery notice.
Principles.PRIN-002: Core owns declaration parsing, resolution, and diagnostic facts; integrations own presentation only.
Principles.PRIN-003: The same event and mode produce equivalent messages in every supported integration.

Requirements.REQ-001: Both modes show delivery notices and operational failures while preserving the original read result.
Requirements.REQ-002: Mode selection: `FLI_DIAGNOSTICS` from the host process environment; unset or `default` selects default; `strict` selects strict; an unsupported value produces one visible configuration notice per session and uses default while delivery continues; values are case-sensitive; a mode change takes effect at harness startup.
Requirements.REQ-003: A read with an empty result or only previously delivered ancestors produces no per-read notice.
Requirements.REQ-004: Strict mode additionally shows declaration and selector diagnostics; valid independent branches still deliver context; semantics and read classification are unchanged.
Requirements.REQ-005: Delivery notices list newly delivered documents in Core order using structured identities and project-relative paths, qualifying the project when equal relative paths from different projects occur in one notice.
Requirements.REQ-006: Show up to three names inline; beyond that include the total and the number omitted; a full untruncated list remains inspectable through an explicit status/diagnostic surface when one exists.
Requirements.REQ-007: Diagnostic notices identify the observed file and the selector when available; message content is canonical (e.g. `FLI: context added — docs/a.md`, `FLI: context unavailable — ...`), rendered in each harness's native notice surface.
Requirements.REQ-008: Model delivery and notice visibility are verified in each real harness.
